message.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.coming: Something moves in the trees, and keeps pace with you. The Huntsman's rangers know what you've killed.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.caught: %s: "The wood can't feed that many of your kind. You're coming with me."
message.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.delivered: %s carries you, trussed like a buck, to %s, and hands you to its guards for poaching.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.let_off: %s: "No court for days. Go, and kill less."
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.scold: "%s beasts since yesterday. The Huntsman takes the old and the slow, and leaves the rest to breed. Take that many again and I'll be the one hunting you."
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.offer: "You walk the woods like you've no trade. I could teach you ours. Which of the wild's enemies would you hunt?"
message.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.taught: You walk the rest of the day with the ranger, and come out of the trees a Ranger.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.lesson.1: "Take the old and the slow. Leave the young, or there's nothing here next year."
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.lesson.2: "Walk upwind of what you hunt. It smells you long before it sees you."
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.lesson.3: "Where the deer are thick, the wolves aren't far. Where the wolves are gone, the deer eat the wood bare."
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.lesson.4: "A clean kill and every part used. Anything less is a debt to the Huntsman."
